title: Personal Style Score
description: A live 0–100 score for every outfit based on color harmony, fit and occasion — level up your wardrobe, one look at a time.

title: Outfit Calendar
description: Plans your looks for the whole week — from boardroom to brunch. Never repeat an outfit without knowing it.

title: Seasonal Capsules
description: Auto-builds a 15-piece capsule each season from what you own, so a smaller wardrobe always feels infinite.

title: 24/7 AI Stylist Chat
description: Ask anything — "what should I wear on a first date?" — and get an instant, honest answer that suits you.

title: Sustainable Picks
description: Swap suggestions for eco-friendly fabrics, and know your carbon saved every time you re-wear instead of re-buy.

title: In-store Match
description: Point your camera at any rack. StyleMe tells you instantly: suits you, clashes, or needs a different size.
